note: Short answer cards for rule-shaped prompts. Each card names ONE file in the vault and ONE verbatim quote. At load time the quote is checked byte-for-byte against that file; a card whose quote no longer matches is dropped, so the fast path cannot answer from a stale or invented rule. A card is a pointer with provenance, never approval and never proof of anything outside the file.

cards.answer: A summary line is 40 to 80 visible characters, punctuation and spaces included.
cards.superseded_note: Raised on 2026-01-14; the 30 to 80 range is historical and is not applied.

cards.answer: A claim with no named source is recorded as an open question, not written as a fact.
cards.quote: a claim with no named source; never written as a fact
